name: oxblood-lime-funky
description: Dark Linear-like theme. Canvas is oxblood #220C10. Primary highlight is lime #6AFF00. Accents: aqua (system), magenta (human/social), ivory (soft light). One neon per component.
rules: Lime is the only neon on a given component. Aqua or ivory supports it.
Do not place full-strength primary next to full-strength magenta on a large area.
Prefer warm off-white text (#F4EEE8) over cold gray or pure white.
Danger must stay brighter than the oxblood base or it will vanish.
Success reuses primary. Do not introduce a second green.
